1_grad_logger_alignment.problem: Prior every-10-step bucket_grad_l2 was a second SDRP backward on train_batches[0] only, while the Adam step averages 11 train structures. Projector sawtooth was primarily a measurement property, not a model property.
1_grad_logger_alignment.requirement: spine/euc_skip/dark bucket_grad_l2 logged at step 0 and every LOG_EVERY must come from the same multi-structure backward used for the training step (mean over the 11 train structures' SDRP loss, or equivalently the backward that produced the clipped grads before optimizer.step). No separate single-structure probe for the standing heatmap/curves.
1_grad_logger_alignment.why: Otherwise every future step-0 heatmap requires mentally discounting projector variance — re-litigating this finding. Fix once in the runner.
1_grad_logger_alignment.acceptance_test: tests/v8/test_wrap1_zhyp_logger_align.py — logged bucket_grad_l2 equals multi-structure train backward (within float tol); source forbids hold[0] probe.
1_grad_logger_alignment.does_not_change: G_grad_spine membership gate (A) semantics; only the telemetry source.

2_G_grad_spine_split_A_and_B.status: DESIGN_FORM_LOCKED — numeric B threshold NOT locked until baseline from completed M2 step-0 distribution + operator sign

A_membership.name: G_grad_spine
A_membership.definition: NONE | ZERO | NZ trichotomy; spine buckets NZ with grad_l2 > 0.0; dark buckets NONE under SDRP-only. Unchanged from assert_sdrp_live_spine_reachable.
A_membership.measures: graph membership / wiring — not utilization strength

B_relative_floor.name: G_grad_spine_rel
B_relative_floor.why_not_absolute: Raw grad_l2 floors (e.g. 1e-4) change meaning as CE saturates: healthy step-0 magnitudes look 'starved' by step 300 on every fold of this card. Same class of silent semantic drift as train-time moe_load_e* earlier this month.
B_relative_floor.definition_draft: At each logged step t (including step 0), for each bucket b in {attn_layers, projector, moe}: require grad_l2[b](t) / grad_l2[sdrp_head](t) >= r_min[b], using grads from the aligned train backward (decision 1). sdrp_head is the reference because it is the loss-local head under SDRP-live sole loss.
B_relative_floor.alternative_considered: ratio to total preclip param-grad norm — rejected as primary because preclip mixes frontend+spine and clip regime; keep as diagnostic only.
B_relative_floor.r_min_status: NOT LOCKED. M2 step-0 baseline (near-constant across 12 folds): attn/sdrp≈0.339, projector/sdrp≈0.195, moe/sdrp≈0.031. Operator signs r_min before any next prereg READY_TO_RUN.
B_relative_floor.when_evaluated: At minimum step 0 (wiring+relative health). Optional: also require the ratio not collapse below r_min/2 for >K consecutive log points — separate sub-bar, only if signed.
B_relative_floor.fail_name: WEAK_SPINE_REL (does not imply ABORT_WIRING; membership A can still PASS)

B2_euc_skip_share.name: G_euc_skip_share
B2_euc_skip_share.status: REQUIRED companion diagnostic on next DualSpace / SDRP-live capacity card — form locked; numeric bar unsigned
B2_euc_skip_share.why: M2 left euc_skip compensation SUSPECTED (8/12). If euc_skip soaks gradient that a healthier spine would use for minority classes (CORE/DEHYDRON_RIM), a spine-only ratio bar (B) can PASS while the compensation failure mode continues. Track euc_skip share explicitly so SUSPECTED cannot stay invisible to the next card's instrumentation.
B2_euc_skip_share.definition_draft: At each logged step t from the aligned train backward: euc_share(t) = grad_l2[euc_skip](t) / (grad_l2[euc_skip](t) + sum_{b in SPINE_NZ} grad_l2[b](t)). Log euc_share alongside B ratios.
B2_euc_skip_share.hypothesis_tied_to_M2: Compensation suspicion: late euc_share rises while spine/sdrp ratios fall and minority-class F1 stays at majority-only floor.
bar_options_for_operator_sign: DIAGNOSTIC_ONLY — log + report; no pass/fail (minimum for next card)
SOFT_CAP — fail WEAK_SPINE_REL or flag COMPENSATION if euc_share(t) > s_max for >K consecutive late log points while any spine/sdrp ratio is below r_min[b]
HARD_CAP — euc_share(t) <= s_max at step 0 and mean(late) — only if operator wants DualSpace balance as a locked gate
B2_euc_skip_share.default_until_signed: DIAGNOSTIC_ONLY on the next card — must be logged; numeric s_max not invented here
B2_euc_skip_share.depends_on: decision 1 (aligned train backward) — otherwise euc_share inherits the same probe artifact as projector

3_euc_skip_compensation_prestated.hypothesis: Late DualSpace euc_skip branch grows while hyperbolic spine buckets floor — possible compensation for something the spine is not learning.
3_euc_skip_compensation_prestated.m2_result: SUSPECTED — carried into B2_euc_skip_share for next card; do not retune M2 bars.

fold_matches_compensation_pattern.rationale: Requires both late euc_skip growth (geometrically meaningful vs mid) and broad spine collapse toward peak — not euc_skip alone (1LYZ can fall) and not a single noisy spine bucket.
